properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 InterfacesAndAddresses activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AcceptAddressTransfer", "Execute", "Elastic IP Address",
    "AllocateAddress", "Create", "Elastic IP Address",
    "AssignIpv6Addresses", "Set", "Network Interface",
    "AssignPrivateIpAddresses", "Set", "Network Interface",
    "AssociateAddress", "Set", "Elastic IP Association",
    "AssociateTrunkInterface", "Set", "Trunk Network Interface",
    "AttachNetworkInterface", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "CreateNetworkInterface", "Create", "Network Interface",
    "CreateNetworkInterfacePermission", "Create", "Network Interface Permission",
    "DeleteNetworkInterface", "Delete", "Network Interface",
    "DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission", "Delete", "Network Interface Permission",
    "DescribeAddressTransfers", "Read", "Elastic Ip Address Transfer",
    "DescribeAddresses", "Read", "Elastic Ip Address",
    "DescribeAddressesAttribute", "Read", "Elastic Ip Address",
    "DescribeMovingAddresses", "Read", "Elastic IP address",
    "DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "Read", "Network Interface",
    "DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions", "Read", "Network Interface",
    "DescribeNetworkInterfaces", "Read", "Network Interface",
    "DescribeTrunkInterfaceAssociations", "Read", "Trunk Interface Association",
    "DetachNetworkInterface", "Set", "Network Interface",
    "DisableAddressTransfer", "Disable", "Elastic IP Address",
    "DisassociateAddress", "Delete", "Elastic IP Address",
    "DisassociateTrunkInterface", "Delete", "Trunk Interface Association",
    "EnableAddressTransfer", "Enable", "Elastic IP Address",
    "ModifyAddressAttribute", "Set", "Elastic IP address",
    "ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "Set", "Network Interface",
    "MoveAddressToVpc", "Execute", "Elastic Ip Address",
    "ReleaseAddress", "Delete", "Elastic IP address",
    "ResetAddressAttribute", "Execute", "Elastic IP address",
    "ResetNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "Execute", "Network Interface",
    "RestoreAddressToClassic", "Set", "Elastic Ip Address",
    "UnassignIpv6Addresses", "Delete", "Network Interface",
    "UnassignPrivateIpAddresses", "Delete", "Network Interface",
    "ValidateSecurityGroupQuotasForInterface", "Execute", "Network Interface Security Group Quotas"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "AllocateAddress", ResponseElements.allocationId,
      EventName == "AssignIpv6Addresses", ResponseElements.assignedIpv6Addresses,
      EventName == "AssignPrivateIpAddresses", ResponseElements.assignedIpv4PrefixSet,
      EventName == "AssociateAddress", ResponseElements.associationId,
      EventName == "AssociateTrunkInterface", ResponseElements.interfaceAssociation,
      EventName == "AttachNetworkInterface", ResponseElements.attachmentId,
      EventName == "CreateNetworkInterface", ResponseElements.networkInterface,
      EventName == "CreateNetworkInterfacePermission", ResponseElements.interfacePermission,
      EventName == "EnableAddressTransfer", ResponseElements.addressTransfer,
      EventName in ("ModifyAddressAttribute", "ResetAddressAttribute"), ResponseElements.address,
      EventName == "MoveAddressToVpc", ResponseElements.status,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName == "AcceptAddressTransfer", ResponseElements.addressTransfer,
      EventName == "AllocateAddress", ResponseElements.allocationId,
      EventName in ("AssignIpv6Addresses", "AssignPrivateIpAddresses", "AssociateAddress",
        "DeleteNetworkInterface", "DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "DescribeNetworkInterfaces",
        "ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "ResetNetworkInterfaceAttribute", "UnassignIpv6Addresses",
        "UnassignPrivateIpAddresses"), RequestParameters.NetworkInterfaceId,
      EventName == "AssociateTrunkInterface", RequestParameters.TrunkInterfaceId,
      EventName == "AttachNetworkInterface", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "CreateNetworkInterface", ResponseElements.networkInterface.networkInterfaceId,
      EventName == "CreateNetworkInterfacePermission",
        ResponseElements.interfacePermission.interfacePermissionId,
      EventName in ("DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission", "DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions"),
        RequestParameters.NetworkInterfacePermissionId,
      EventName == "DescribeAddressTransfers", ResponseElements.addressTransferSet,
      EventName == "DescribeAddresses", ResponseElements.addressesSet,
      EventName == "DescribeAddressesAttribute", ResponseElements.addressSet,
      EventName in ("DescribeTrunkInterfaceAssociations", "DisassociateAddress", "DisassociateTrunkInterface"),
        RequestParameters.AssociationId,
      EventName == "DetachNetworkInterface", RequestParameters.AttachmentId,
      EventName in ("DisableAddressTransfer", "EnableAddressTransfer", "ModifyAddressAttribute",
        "ReleaseAddress", "ResetAddressAttribute"), RequestParameters.AllocationId,
      EventName in ("MoveAddressToVpc", "RestoreAddressToClassic"), RequestParameters.PublicIp,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
